prompt.description: The narrative prompt or instruction shown to the player.

prefix.description: Optional text prefix displayed before the selected word sequence.

correct_sequence.description: The correct sequence of words the player must select in order.

confuse_words.description: Distractor words mixed in with the correct ones.

max_time_seconds.description: Optional countdown timer in seconds. Auto-submits when time expires.

success.description: Whether the player selected the correct sequence.

selected_sequence.description: The sequence of words the player selected.

time_spent_seconds.description: Time the player spent before submitting.
